_comment: How the dictionary lays out the words that come back beside the one searched. The first result is read in full; the rest sit in a grid of small cards so the forms of one root can be compared at a glance. A card takes two columns only when that saves two lines or more (a sense wraps every 'wrap-letters' letters in one column) or it has synonyms. Rows keep the order, as few as possible and as even as possible, and a row short of full gives its spare columns to the card in it that wraps most. lib/entrySpan.js is the only reader.

entry._comment: How an Arabic dictionary entry (Lisan, Taj al-Arus) is set as paragraphs. The books arrive either wrapped at the printed line, Taj every forty letters, or as one unbroken block, Lisan on a common root twelve thousand letters. Both are joined, cut at full stops, and the sentences gathered until a paragraph holds at least paragraph-letters. lib/entryLines.js is the only reader.

root-meaning._book_comment: How Ibn Faris's book is named over its card (components/dictionary/BookHeader.jsx), the same line every book on the shelf has. died is a Hijri year.
root-meaning._comment: The classical root card (RootMeaningCard.jsx). rest-lines: how many lines of the rest of Ibn Faris's entry show before 'Show the rest'.

classical._comment: The classical dictionaries under a root (Dictionary.jsx, ClassicalRoot), one book shown at a time from one switch. books is the order of the switch and each book's short name on it, by the id the backend files it under; maqayees is Ibn Faris's Maqayees al-Lugha, the rest come from /dictionary/lexicons. A book the backend sends that is not listed here goes at the end under its own title. lib/dictionary/classicalBooks.js is the only reader.
